Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misattributed Jorge Brum do Canto’s birth year as 1963 (confusing the film’s release year with the director’s birth year). Earlier evidence correctly established his birth as 1910 and Monte Hellman’s as 1929. This error led to the incorrect conclusion that The Shooting’s director was born earlier, when in fact Retalhos Da Vida De Um Médico’s director (1910) was earlier.
